name: banking77_v6b
instructions: A customer of a digital bank (app-based account with cards, top-ups, transfers, currency exchange) sent this message to support. Which single intent best describes what the customer is asking about? Pick the most specific intent that matches the customer's main concern.

criteria.activate_my_card: how to activate a newly received card for the first time; activation steps or problems activating a new card (not reactivating an old/found card)
criteria.age_limit: minimum age to open an account; can children/teenagers use the service
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: using Apple Pay, Google Pay, or phone wallets with the card; top up via Apple Pay
criteria.atm_support: where ATMs are, which ATMs accept the card, can I use the card at ATMs
criteria.automatic_top_up: auto top-up feature: how it works, turning it on/off
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: money transferred into the customer's own account is not showing in their balance yet; complaint that the balance is taking long to update after a transfer
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: customer deposited money (a cheque, cash, or an unspecified deposit) and the balance has not changed / deposit not showing / cheque slow to clear
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: unable to add a beneficiary/payee, beneficiary not allowed or rejected; having trouble sending money to a beneficiary
criteria.cancel_transfer: wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made (sent by mistake, wrong account)
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card is expiring or expired; getting a replacement for an expiring card
criteria.card_acceptance: where the card is accepted; card not accepted by a merchant or shop
criteria.card_arrival: customer already ordered a physical card and it has not arrived in the mail / is late / may be lost; tracking it
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes, when a card will arrive, express delivery, how the card is sent
criteria.card_linking: linking a card to the account/app; reactivating a card; linking or re-adding a card that was found again or is already in the app
criteria.card_not_working: physical card is not working / stopped working in general (not specifically contactless, ATM withdrawal, or a declined payment)
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: charged a fee or extra for a card payment or purchase; why was I charged extra for using my card
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: a card payment they don't recognise / didn't make on the statement
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong, bad or erroneous exchange rate applied / charged on a card payment or purchase
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: charged a fee for withdrawing cash from an ATM
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: a cash withdrawal or cash transaction showing up in the app that they didn't make or don't recognise
criteria.change_pin: how to change or set the PIN
criteria.compromised_card: card details may be compromised or used fraudulently / someone else may have used the card; security concerns about the card (card itself not lost)
criteria.country_support: which countries the service or cards are available in; whether people living outside the UK/a given country can get an account or card; using the account while living or moving abroad
criteria.declined_card_payment: card payment was declined / rejected at a shop or online
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM cash withdrawal was declined / could not withdraw cash
criteria.declined_transfer: a transfer was declined / not allowed to go through
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: a direct debit on the account they don't recognise
criteria.disposable_card_limits: limits specific to disposable virtual cards: how many times a disposable card can be used, how many disposable cards I can create
criteria.edit_personal_details: change personal details: name, address, email, phone number
criteria.exchange_charge: fees charged for currency exchange; exchange fees on weekends; extra charge when exchanging
criteria.exchange_rate: what the exchange rate is, where it comes from, how it is calculated
criteria.exchange_via_app: how to carry out a currency exchange in the app; steps for doing an exchange
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: an unexpected extra charge or small extra amount (e.g. an extra £1/$1) on the statement they don't understand
criteria.failed_transfer: a transfer failed / did not go through / was returned
criteria.fiat_currency_support: whether a specific fiat currency (e.g. EUR, USD) is supported or allowed; can I exchange into / hold / pay in a particular currency; which currencies are supported
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: how to get or create a disposable (single-use) virtual card
criteria.get_physical_card: getting a physical card (e.g. have a virtual card, want a physical one); finding the PIN/code for the physical card
criteria.getting_spare_card: getting an additional or spare card, a card for a family member; how many cards I can have in total on my account
criteria.getting_virtual_card: how to get a (non-disposable) virtual card; fees for a virtual card; virtual card not yet received or not appearing in the app
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: card lost or stolen or missing; help retrieving or finding my card; freeze/block a lost card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: phone lost or stolen; access the account without the phone
criteria.order_physical_card: how to order a new physical card; card ordering process, cost, card design; where/which places cards can be shipped or delivered to
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot the app passcode/password; reset passcode
criteria.pending_card_payment: a payment (card purchase) is pending or has not gone through / not completed yet
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: a cash withdrawal is showing as pending
criteria.pending_top_up: a top-up is pending / taking long to complete
criteria.pending_transfer: a transfer the customer made is shown with pending status / still processing in the app
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblock PIN
criteria.receiving_money: how to receive money / salary / payments from others into the account
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: a refund the merchant already issued or promised has not appeared in my account / my refund is missing
criteria.request_refund: asking for a refund or about the refund process in general: how to get money back, how long refunds take, can I get a refund
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: a card payment to a merchant/seller that was reverted / returned / reversed / cancelled; money deducted for a purchase then came back, or seller says the payment didn't go through
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) and currencies can be used to top up or are supported
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: fee for topping up with a card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up with cash or a cheque
criteria.top_up_failed: a top-up failed / did not work / was declined
criteria.top_up_limits: maximum / minimum top-up amount; top-up limits
criteria.top_up_reverted: a top-up was reverted / cancelled / money returned after topping up; top-up disappeared
criteria.topping_up_by_card: how to top up using a card; card top-up process or issues adding a card for top-up
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: charged a fee for a transfer; complaint that they were charged although they thought transfers were free
criteria.transfer_into_account: how to transfer money into my account / top up by bank transfer
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: customer sent a transfer out to someone else or another account and the recipient/destination hasn't received it yet (hours or days later)
criteria.transfer_timing: general question about how long transfers take to arrive or be processed (not a specific transfer the recipient is missing)
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: trying to verify identity but it fails / can't complete verification
criteria.verify_my_identity: how to verify identity; the steps and documents needed for verification
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: verifying, proving or finding out the source of funds / where the money in my account comes from or flows from
criteria.verify_top_up: verifying a card top-up; can't find or didn't get the verification code for a top-up or card transfer into the account
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: virtual card is not working / declined
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: is the card Visa or Mastercard; choosing card network
criteria.why_verify_identity: why identity verification is needed; do I really have to verify my identity at all
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less cash than requested
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: complaint that the exchange rate applied when withdrawing or getting cash (ATM abroad) was wrong or too high / received less cash than expected due to rate
